answer: Copying the same citations across 192 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 192 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. Because the whisper index resolves every citation against the bridge checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the tundra audit keeps the resolved set. A farm of 3499 identities would post 4280 proofs and burn roughly 26 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
